title: JSOC crash retrievals and Knights of Malta

tellings.quote: According to journalist Seymour Hirsch, one of the modern heads of Joc, General Stanley Mcristel, and many of the members of JOC themselves are all Knights of Malta.

plain: A modern head of the Joint Special Operations Command, the US military command over its most elite special forces units, General Stanley McChrystal, is said to belong to the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic order of knights, and so are many of the command's own members. Michels raises this in an episode with a former presidential advisor, crediting the investigative journalist Seymour Hersh. It matters to him because this same command comes up in talk of secret recoveries of crashed craft, and the claim would tie that work to a private religious order.
